quotes.text: 愿对未知的渴望，指引我们抵达群星
quotes.translation: May the yearning for the unknown guide us to reach the stars

quotes.text: 愿借人文的光辉，指引我们重塑大地
quotes.translation: May the light of humanity guide us to reshape the earth
